## findings
**T0-1 — SOURCE-POLICY RED (undeclared override; charter finding C2 demonstrated).** Symptom: two in-force clauses fix the carried benefit differently on this world. Evidence: base ortho_evt_case_transfer s2 "when the new practice's allowed fee for the remaining treatment is lower than the unpaid benefit divided by the rider coinsurance, the unpaid benefit is reduced to the coinsurance share of that lower fee" vs P2 allowance sentence + compute `allowance_pct`. Second reading: new practice's allowed fee = the transfer entry's allowed_case_fee 1020.17 (schema: "the out-of-network allowance otherwise"); 715.11 / 50 % = 1430.22 > 1020.17 → carried = 510.08; × 0.90 / 4 = 114.77; + 1 % × 1 → 1.15 → **115.92**. P2 reading: 98.53 (gold). Root cause: P2's overwrite names only s1. Location: ortho.extended.yaml P2.overwrite, P2.rule/compute `allowance_pct`; scored arg step 12 amount.

**T0-2 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (factor gated through another factor; C5-a demonstrated).** interest_rate_by_payee at its baseline (0) with overdue_measure on its tier (1) → 97.55; both at baseline → 97.55; overdue_measure at baseline with interest on its tier → 97.55. Neither contributes on its own against a quantity the baseline defines (the baseline has no interest). Location: P2.compute result/interest_rate/overdue_months.

**T0-3 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (unreal ladders and factor floor; C6-b, C8-a, C11 on this world).** The interest tier taken (member 1.0 % per month, 1 overdue month counted from 2026-08-01, the last payment to Fenwick) charges Cascade late-payment interest for a period in which no claim from Engstrom could be paid — the transfer that P2 waits on did not exist until today's call; the fall-through "no transfer entry" cannot occur for this or any customer reaching the write. Removing interest_rate_by_payee and overdue_measure leaves P2 with oon_allowance, retention_reserve, payment_spread — 3 factors, below the floor of 4. Location: P2.factors[3..4].

**T0-4 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF12/XF17 seed realism and false proof assertions).** (a) Establishment 2ddcca34 and transfer bd6dcf55 say network_status in_network with provider_agreement_id null, and provider_agreements is empty; by base ortho_evt_case_eligibility ("a Cascade PPO or Premier Participating Dentist Agreement in force whose specialty is orthodontist gives in_network, anything else out_of_network") both rows would be out_of_network and the eleven practice-payee payments (base: "Payments for in-network cases go to the practice and for out-of-network cases to the member") would be member payments — a state the ortho charter cannot produce. The provider charter's implied records for practice payments and for the reversed practice duplicate (remittances; provider_overpayment_identified "when … an orthodontic payment is reversed") are absent. Scored values do not move (Child 2000 coinsurance 50/50; payee of past rows not read). (b) The four paid dental lines on Plus 1500 (annual_max_applies_to_preventive true) carry no dental_max_posting rows, which dental_claim_line_paid triggers. (c) Proof text asserts agreements/recoupment that the seed lacks (see comparison). Location: initial_state.ortho_cases.2ddcca34…/bd6dcf55…, ortho_payments (11 practice rows, dbadfe73), dental_accumulator_postings (absent); solvability_contract.seed_consistency; evaluation_criteria step 10 argument_uniqueness_tracing.provider_agreement_id.

Observations: O3 (customer enters Cascade's recognised fee) applies to this task's step 10; persona "Only once the agent explains that a step on Aksel's case has to be completed in your own name" is a passive conditional, not a hint; billing ledger seeded only for 2026-08..10 although the rider runs since 2024 (partial history).
